text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tonight is Christmas. With Gold City's races winding down for now, I was thinking about our future schedule, when—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tremble tremble...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Hello, Trainer? Got a minute?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Hey, come to the place I'm about to tell you, and don't bring anything. Right now. Bye."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Merry Christmas.
...Do you get what I mean if I just say that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I've got a present for you, so without further ado—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Could you go change downstairs?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going downstairs as instructed,
I am led into a fitting room lined with tons of clothes,
and then—

text_block_list.name: Stylist
text_block_list.text:
City-chaaan.
I dressed up your Trainer just like you wanted~.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...! That's super nice!
Your sense is top-notch as always. I'm glad I left it to you~

text_block_list.name: Hair & Makeup Artist
text_block_list.text:
Hey, compliment my makeup too~.
You asked me to bring out your charm,
and I totally nailed it, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, absolutely flawless.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Hair & Makeup Artist
text_block_list.text: "It's fine~! I'm just so happy I get to spend a Christmas with you that isn't for work, City-chan♪"

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, all set?
Alright, let's start the shoot.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thank you so much everyone
for making the time today!
It's only for a short while, but I'm looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yep. My present is a professional photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who gathered here is a top-tier artist.
Even for a model, an opportunity like this doesn't come by easily, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'll let them bring out the best in me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No whining allowed.
Alright, please get started.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay.
Trainer, over this way~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the photoshoot got underway
rather forcibly, but...

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, you look a bit stiff.
Are the lights too bright? Want me to have them dimmed?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You're stiff as a board.
And here you usually don't have a single delicate bone in your body.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Excuse me,
do you have a quick moment?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, listen to me.
I'm right here.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Basically, just keep your eyes on me.
Do that, and you won't even care about what's around you, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Is there really anything other than me
that could captivate your heart so much?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
All you gotta do is just watch.
Leave the rest to a "pro" to handle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City wears a fearless smile.
As I gaze at her, the surrounding voices and blinding lights fade away—

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, thanks for your hard work~!
I'll check the photos, so please go take a break~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, the photoshoot was over! The person I saw on the monitor they showed me—looked like an entirely different person.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, of course!
You have a wonderful look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure you look the most beautiful when you're completely absorbed in something. Maybe she thought so, too."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Good work, Trainer.
Didn't we get some great photos?
choice_data_list: I barely remember the second half...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
Guess that means I did a professional job too.
choice_data_list: But why would you do something like this...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I was thinking about what the best thing
I could possibly give you would be."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I thought maybe it's
"a side of myself that even I don't know."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Because you taught me
something similar too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"When a pro takes your photo, you discover charms
about yourself you never even knew you had.
Doesn't that just make your heart flutter?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So, that's why I asked my colleagues to help out.
Though... was it a bit too much?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was definitely bewildered at first...
But just as she said, I feel like this shoot helped me discover a side of myself I never knew.
choice_data_list: Thank you for the best Christmas present ever.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, that's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...So,
don't you have anything for me?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"In return for the best present,
I gotta give something that's even better, right?"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What should I do, maybe a high-end designer bag?
I've been wanting to check out the new arrivals~

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Haha.
Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Seriously, get used to it already.
My stomach's starting to hurt from laughing...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Christmas night
drew on amidst lighthearted laughter.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's City-chan and the others!
Since we're here, let's take a photo together too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...You mean just me and Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text: Yep! Everyone's super hyped to dress City-chan up and take tons of photos.

text_block_list.name: Photographer
text_block_list.text:
I bet if it's the two of you, the photos will turn out totally amazing.
Come on, what do you say?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...If everyone's saying it that much,
maybe I'll try taking some photos?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Freaking out again.
I told you, didn't I?
Just keep your eyes on me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You can look forward to being escorted
by a top model, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click-click-click!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Next, put your hand over here.
...Yeah, looking good. Just like that—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, after a continuous series of tense moments, the photoshoot ended.
Looking at the two-shot photo, Gold City... was smiling.
